assertion_audit.fails_if: The verb's answer stops echoing the edited budget; the literal is the value handed in, so this is a weak echo check rather than an independent oracle.
Removing the time_budget write in queue_edit.py leaves 20m stored and reddens this.
Reverting reckon/crew/queue_edit.py:512 drops the key and reddens this with a KeyError; the expected text is the literal reckon/crew/node.py:1552 produces.
A lowered budget that is not stored keeps 35m and reddens this.
Preserving the old note instead of the recomputed one leaves a 35m note on a request declaring 20m; reckon/crew/node.py:1540 is what clears it.

assertion_independence: No assertion compares a call result against a variable the test itself passed in; the note assertions compare against literals reckon/crew/node.py:1552 produces, and the budget assertions compare against the literals handed in, which is a weak echo check rather than a self-comparison.
call_sites: reckon/crew/dispatching/requests.py:93 -> TaskNode.as_dict (a queued dispatch stores the same note)
evidence_limits: No suite rerun; the reviewed run's own baseline_suite and after_suite logs were read at 0 failures on both arms, so no failure ids are counted as added.

The queue-verb gate logs name host, revision, tree, command, module.__file__, cwd and slurm_job_id_in_env <unset> but not the all_debug partition or a job id; those appear only in the manifest's artifacts line.
The ruff check and ruff format --check obligations are stated in the manifest and fragment but no log of either run is stored.
The fragment's head suite timing (36.55s) does not match the after_suite log at the reviewed head (35.61s), recorded as a non-blocking finding.

findings.text: non-blocking: the fragment cites the head arm as revision c88854f81763df3724e6bde1577cb48761c1c1dc (job 1326336) for logs/head-queue-verbs.log, but that log's header names revision 3630be724acbfc5bfa65659a3abcaf1b344ff4ae and the manifest names job 1326365 for its head arm, so a reader cannot reconcile the quoted arm with the cited log.

non-blocking: the suite head figure is quoted as 58 passed in 36.55s, but 36.55s is the after-arm summary at c88854f817, while the after_suite arm the manifest records at the reviewed head 3630be724acbfc5bfa65659a3abcaf1b344ff4ae reads 58 passed in 35.61s, so the quoted metric belongs to an arm the record does not cite.

non-blocking: the note is copied from the node re-judged before the pointer lock while the stored node_block is re-read under it, so a concurrent edit that changes time_budget between the read and the lock can store a budget beside a note describing a different budget.
